title: Accounting for model error in ensemble variational data assimilation through learned generative dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.17333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many approaches have recently been proposed to combine data assimilation with machine learning for improved forecasts with geophysical models. Here, we focus on combining advanced sequential data assimilation schemes with a generative forecasting model which accounts for complex model errors. This generative model provides a stochastic approximation of the conditional distribution of the successor state given the current state. The proposed variational formulation is a novel one-step weak-constraint 4D-Var scheme in which a learned conditional stochastic forecast replaces the prescribed additive Gaussian model error representation. We derive and implement this formulation as an ensemble variational algorithm, the generative iterative ensemble Kalman filter (IEnKF-G), which generalises the iterative ensemble Kalman filter with additive Gaussian model error (IEnKF-Q). We extend the method to a smoother with an assimilation window spanning

translated_title: 通过学习的生成式动力学在集合变分数据同化中刻画模式误差
translated_abstract: 近年来，许多方法被提出用于将数据同化与机器学习相结合，以改进地球物理模式的预报。本文着重于将先进的顺序数据同化方案与一个能够刻画复杂模式误差的生成式预报模型相结合。该生成模型在给定当前状态的条件下，对后继状态的条件分布提供随机近似。所提出的变分形式是一种新颖的单步弱约束4D-Var方案，其中用学习到的条件随机预报取代了预先设定的加性高斯模式误差表示。我们将该形式推导并实现为一种集合变分算法——生成式迭代集合卡尔曼滤波器，它推广了带有加性高斯模式误差的迭代集合卡尔曼滤波器。我们进一步将该方法扩展为同化窗口跨越（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出生成式迭代集合卡尔曼滤波器（IEnKF-G），用学习到的条件随机生成预报模型取代传统设定的加性高斯模式误差表示，在新颖的单步弱约束4D-Var框架中更好地刻画复杂模式误差。
en_tdlr: Proposes the generative Iterative Ensemble Kalman Filter (IEnKF-G), which replaces the prescribed additive Gaussian model error representation with a learned conditional stochastic generative forecast model within a novel one-step weak-constraint 4D-Var scheme.
